properties.method: Seligman 1932 plate georeferenced from 30 printed graticule intersections (28–36°E × 4–14°N), gdal order-2 polynomial, GCP RMS 1.33 km (LOO 1.71 km). The plate draws NO tribal boundary lines, only spread-letter labels. Shape = 0.3° buffer around the line through the centres of the spread letters of the 'NUER' label. The edge is therefore inferred (EDITORIAL), not traced.
properties.basis: Seligman & Seligman 1932, folding Tribal Map of Southern Sudan: placement of the spread label NUER.
properties.temporal_note: Shows the c.1910s–1930s distribution recorded by the Seligmans, not the full span of the era.

sources.citation: C.G. Seligman & B.Z. Seligman, Pagan Tribes of the Nilotic Sudan (London: Routledge, 1932), folding plate 'Tribal Map of Southern Sudan' (unpaginated, end of volume; graticule 24–36°E, 4–16°N)
sources.plate: folding 'Tribal Map of Southern Sudan', scan leaf n717 of in.gov.ignca.2109

properties.note: The separate spread label 'JEKAING' (32.7–33.9°E, 9.2°N) is not included: the plate doesn't tie it to NUER.
